version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: This is a local HR statutory-cost checker that reads user-provided materials and prints results, with no evidence of network use, persistence, or hidden execution.

dimensions.detail: Read access to user-selected local HR/finance text files and Bash to run Node are proportionate to the stated local checking workflow; the scripts use standard library file reads and directory listing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, dependency fetch, remote payload retrieval, or setup-time mutation was found in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to running the packaged Node script on samples or user-specified input files/directories; no prompt hijacking or unrelated agent instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected code does not write files, install services, modify tools, read credentials, access environment variables, or create persistence; sample execution reported local execution with no network or writes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill coherently implements a Chinese HR/accounting worksheet checker for three top-level areas, but some bundled module text overstates or ambiguously describes sub-check coverage; outputs do list not-run sub-checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving the skill local access to the HR/finance materials you explicitly pass to it. Treat it as an arithmetic and reconciliation aid, not legal, tax, audit, or filing advice, and review the reported checks_not_run/sub_checks_not_run before relying on a clean result.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Partly supported only as a documentation/scope-precision issue: the main pack runs the three advertised top-level checks, but some member module comments and disclaimers describe sub-checks more broadly than the free implementation performs. This is user guidance material, not evidence of malicious tool poisoning.
[AE1] unexpected: Overridden by inspection: scripts/run.mjs was present, fully readable, and executed successfully on the packaged samples; no analysis-evasion behavior was found.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Partly supported as a scope-consistency concern in sub-check documentation, especially around withheld disability-fund and welfare/union checks. The runtime result exposes checks_not_run and sub_checks_not_run, reducing the risk of hidden behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Partly supported: some inline and output text is imprecise about exact validations, such as welfare actual-vs-limit wording. This should be clarified before relying on the tool for compliance decisions, but it does not show exfiltration, persistence, or unsafe authority.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language output is consistent with a China-focused HR statutory cost checker; it is a locale/product-fit issue rather than a security concern.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 security results.
